findings.evidence: `Topology/Circle/Metric.lean:130` defines the underlying `dist_circleMap_sq`; the four declarations at `Crosscut/Basic.lean:220,232,244,256` use only metric ball membership, squared inequalities, and that identity.
findings.fix: Move all four declarations (lines 220–259) beside `dist_circleMap_sq` in `TauCeti/Topology/Circle/Metric.lean`, leaving the crosscut-specific specializations in `Crosscut/Basic.lean`.
findings.issue: `circleMap_mem_ball_iff_sq`, `dist_circleMap_lt_iff_sq`, `circleMap_mem_closedBall_iff_sq`, and `dist_circleMap_le_iff_sq` are generic circle/ball metric lemmas with no conformal or crosscut-specific hypotheses, so their current home hides reusable API in later theory.

summary: The general circle–disc membership criteria are placed in a conformal-crosscut module despite being broadly useful metric consequences of the law of cosines.
